messages:
Eli: Quick sync - NorthStar Health POC kickoff tomorrow. Need final confirmation on: sample payloads, client-side redaction rules, where to land data (S3 preferred), and networking approach (VPC peering vs PrivateLink). Also customer asked if trial can be Dedicated or only hosted credits.

Priya: Customer will provide a slice of claims + notes. They emphasized PHI will be present. I'll ask for a sanitized sample and a redaction script they can run pre-upload.

Maya: For success metrics, propose:
- Latency: p95 <= 300ms for 1-2 token prompts
- Throughput: 40 qps sustained during daytime window
- Accuracy: BLEU/F1 target per their evals, baseline > 0.75
- Security: no raw PHI persisted in logs or artifacts
Please confirm these.

Devon: On encryption & audit: hosted supports SSE-KMS (provider-managed) or customer KMS for Private mode. We can enable object-level CloudTrail and S3 access logging. Suggest answering SecQ Q4: "We use KMS-backed encryption and can integrate customer-managed CMKs in Private deployments. Detailed logging available on request."

Samir: Pricing: offer 14-day Dedicated trial (250 GPU hours) if they can approve SOW; otherwise provide $15k hosted credits. We'll include a clause for hosted fallback.

Eli: For uploads, prefer presigned S3 PUTs with a manifest csv. Ask them to limit to ~8k files, with one doc per line (jsonl). Also request the prompt set: 50 prompts + expected outputs for automated scoring.

Priya: Sending manifest template now. Example manifest row:

file_path,doc_count,redaction_applied
s3://ns-poc-uploads/claims_2026_04_01.jsonl,1200,true

Also sharing suggested redaction (client-side):

redaction_rules:
  - id: ssn
    regex: "\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\b"
    replacement: "<REDACTED_SSN>"
  - id: mrn
    regex: "MRN:?[ ]?\\d{6,9}"
    replacement: "<REDACTED_MRN>"

infra-bot: Sandbox bucket created: s3://ns-poc-uploads-1935. Presign endpoint: https://upload.redwood.example/presign/1935 TTL=12h. VPC endpoint vpce-03d1 created.

Devon: Networking options: if they pick VPC peering we need their VPC ID + acceptance from their infra team. For PrivateLink, they must provide route table IDs and security group for the ENI. I'll paste a minimal terraform snippet for PrivateLink in the doc we send them.

Maya: Eval harness - I'll assemble a basic scoring script that computes F1 + exact match and outputs a CSV of results. Will also include a small dashboard template (Grafana) to show latency and error rates.

Eli: Action items recap:
- Priya: collect manifest, redaction script, and prompt set (due today end of day)
- Devon: copyable SecQ responses + terraform snippet (due today)
- Maya: eval harness + dashboard template (due tomorrow)
- Samir: prepare trial SOW and pricing note (due today)

Priya: Pinged customer for manifest. Sending redaction examples and prompt template in the next email.

Samir: I'll attach the SOW to this thread when ready. If legal needs to speed review, will flag.

Devon: One blocker note: If they insist on on-prem HSM for key storage during the POC we need an enterprise agreement and extra lead time. Flagging to sales.

Eli: Noted. Any other blockers?

Priya: None currently.

infra-bot: Reminder: presigned URLs will expire in 12h. Re-provision via /provision if needed.

Eli: Thanks, team. Will run kickoff tomorrow AM and close loop on SOW before then.
